gloss_en: ETABS structural analysis view export contains no element geometry; can geometry be included?
title_original: IFC (Structural Analysis View)
question_paraphrase: ETABS model exported with Structural Analysis View shows nothing in Solibri or BIMsight; can geometry data be put into this view?
phrasing_notes: plain, slightly non-native English, 'I want to know that it is possible to...'
answer_summary: Curve members normally have no solid; material/profile linked by relations. Few viewers show analysis models; try GeometryGym viewer or KIT viewer.

gloss_en: How to share STAAD analysis results through IFC so clients can review without analysis software?
title_original: IfcStructuralAnalysisDomain
question_paraphrase: Wants to export STAAD analysis results (not just the model) so clients can view them in a general BIM viewer; asks whether a custom exporter is needed.
phrasing_notes: polite, practical, names the exact toolchain
answer_summary: Few implementations exchange results; sample in IFC4 Add2 docs; tooling would need building.

gloss_en: Can duct flow be exported in m3/h and pipe flow in l/s from Revit to IFC?
title_original: Supported data type - VolumetricFlowRate - m3/h
question_paraphrase: IFC VolumetricFlowRate is m3/s; user wants duct flow in m3/h and pipe flow in l/s though both use the same parameter name.
phrasing_notes: short, two numbered sub-questions, unit symbols
answer_summary: Units are a display matter; Revit stores internal units; exporter offers only one flow data type.

gloss_en: How to federate separate discipline IFC files (architecture plus structural slab) sharing the same storeys?
title_original: IFC files that reference one another
question_paraphrase: Two files define same project/site/storey with identical GlobalIds but different names; which is master? Wants many small linked files.
answer_summary: STEP supports file references but vendors do not implement; IFC4 XML href or ICDD are alternatives.

gloss_en: How to map rigid links in a structural analysis model exported to IFC?
title_original: Rigid link representation in structural analysis model
question_paraphrase: Mapped nodes to IfcStructuralPointConnection and axes to IfcStructuralCurveMember; is there a dedicated object for rigid links?
answer_summary: No dedicated entity; model as curve member (maybe Varying subtype) with rigid material; few viewers show analysis models.

gloss_en: How to define per-member release behaviour at a structural point connection (frame corner)?
title_original: User-defined point connection between structural elements
question_paraphrase: Member type enum applies to both ends and cannot set per-DOF releases; asks if user-defined point connections are possible.
answer_summary: Use AppliedCondition on IfcRelConnectsStructuralMember with IfcBoundaryCondition.

gloss_en: Should a reducing coupling be IfcPipeFitting CONNECTOR or TRANSITION?
title_original: Best IFC classification for a reducing coupling
question_paraphrase: PVC reducing coupling joins different pipe sizes; CONNECTOR for couplings, but two different ports suggest TRANSITION.
answer_summary: TRANSITION when nominal diameter changes; MagiCAD does the same for ventilation and piping.

gloss_en: How to model field-bent rebar in IFC with fabricated and installed states?
title_original: Field bent rebar
question_paraphrase: Precast girder stirrups project straight and are bent on site; wants both fabricator and final geometry conveyed.
answer_summary: Multiple representations per product allowed in schema but no way to label them; tool support lacking.

gloss_en: Proposes an IfcReinforcingBarGroup entity matching grouping in rebar detailing software.
title_original: There is a need for a reinforcing bar group
question_paraphrase: Detailing software groups bars; IFC lacks a group entity; proposes IfcReinforcingBarGroup.
answer_summary: Discussion on assemblies vs bar-by-bar aggregation.

gloss_en: Are rebar attributes like cover and spacing (10 mm at 100 c/c) defined by buildingSMART and where stored?
title_original: Does these attributes are defined by buildingSMART or not?
question_paraphrase: Asks where rebar cover and bar spacing data live in IFC.
answer_summary: Not detailed in snippet.

gloss_en: IFC import fails with IFCPOSTALADDRESS attached to rebar objects; why?
title_original: Postal address of rebar windmill foundation
question_paraphrase: Import fails on postal address linked to rebar; asks why addresses attach to rebar.
answer_summary: Not in snippet.

gloss_en: Where to store reinforcing bar lap length data.
title_original: ReinforcingBar Lap Lengths
question_paraphrase: Lap lengths for rebar; reply suggests per individual bar not assembly.
answer_summary: Apply at bar level.

gloss_en: Property sets of IfcSpace, thermal design values such as Pset_SpaceThermalDesign.
title_original: PropertySets of IfcSpace
question_paraphrase: HVAC-relevant space data (thermal design) and intermediate calculated results in IfcSpace psets.
answer_summary: Not in snippet.

gloss_en: Received MEP IFC files where some components are coloured and others grey; which MVD drops system colours?
title_original: whats the root cause of grey MEP-components in IFC
question_paraphrase: Some MEP components grey; suspects MVD issue.
answer_summary: Colours come from material not view filters/overrides; set material colour, use IFC2x3 CV2.0 or IFC4 Reference View.

gloss_en: Pipes/ducts export system material (e.g. HOT WATER) instead of real material (copper).
title_original: Pipes / ducts / etc export using system material not actual material
question_paraphrase: Pipe material exported as system name; unreliable since one system has mixed materials.
answer_summary: Designed per user demand; tracked internally REVIT-236144, open.

gloss_en: Cannot export property sets on IfcSystem from Revit systems browser.
title_original: Revit cannot export properties of an IfcSystem
question_paraphrase: Tried user-defined psets but none appear on IfcSystem.
answer_summary: Maintainers first called it by-design limitation, later revised.

gloss_en: IFC4 changes port connection to IfcRelNests; how does Revit connect ports?
title_original: IfcRelConnectsPortToElement
question_paraphrase: Heater-to-port relation changed in IFC4; asks how Revit does dynamic port connection.
answer_summary: Clarified IfcRelNests vs IfcRelConnectsPortToElement.

gloss_en: Flow parameter must be L/s but appears in ft3/s in IFC.
title_original: Flow Units export to Ifc not correct (revit 2020)
question_paraphrase: Tested base quantities, custom pset, volumetricFlowRate; all wrong units.
answer_summary: Maintainers analysed file; unit scaling issue.

gloss_en: Airflow properties not scaled from Revit internal units on a real project.
title_original: Airflow properties not scaled from revit internal units
question_paraphrase: Air Flow value in IFC wrong scale; project upgrading and relies on fix.
answer_summary: L/s bug; workaround change display unit.

gloss_en: Status/timeline on Revit IFC4 MEP export certification.
title_original: IFC4 MEP certification
question_paraphrase: Asks when Revit export will be IFC4 MEP certified.
answer_summary: Progress shared; certification (IFC4 RV1.2) finished 2022-04-27.

gloss_en: Do Not Exported categories in mapping table mean they can never be exported?
title_original: Not Exported Categories
question_paraphrase: Asks if categories set to Not Exported can be assigned a class.
answer_summary: Yes, e.g. grids can be set to IfcGrid.

gloss_en: Errors when authoring pipe segments and adding fittings in Bonsai.
title_original: Some errors with pipe segments
question_paraphrase: Tracebacks and having to flip pipes; add fitting fails.
answer_summary: Workaround found by reporter.

gloss_en: Clash points differ with element order; how to extract actual clash geometry?
title_original: Clarification on Clash Detection Points & Alternative Methods for Extracting Clash Geometry
question_paraphrase: Two points per clash vary with order; do not match bbox corners.
answer_summary: Confirmed by others; discussion ongoing.

gloss_en: Loading structural IFC in Bonsai errors on editing analysis model.
title_original: Load Strucutral ifc
question_paraphrase: Edit structural analysis model operator fails, LOADING_3D.
phrasing_notes: auto bug template, typo in title
answer_summary: Asked for file.

gloss_en: bSI structural curve member example no longer displays after Bonsai update.
title_original: Bug: IfcStructuralCurveMembers no longer display after Bonsai v0.8.0 update
question_paraphrase: Example file displayed before, not now.
answer_summary: Structural members hidden by default; toggle filter.

gloss_en: Duct fitting inserted backwards between two rectangular ducts.
title_original: Duct Fitting added backwards (inverted)
question_paraphrase: Add fitting or bend inserts inverted.
answer_summary: Bug when ducts already mitred; fixed partly.

gloss_en: Request utility to auto-route 3D orthogonal duct/pipe path between ports with reducers and elbows.
title_original: Utility function to generate 3D orthogonal path between point A to B for distribution systems
question_paraphrase: Click ports, draw route, auto reduction, upper/lower floor offset.
answer_summary: Duplicate; MEP editing low priority.

gloss_en: Easier load authoring in Bonsai then a PyNite solver.
title_original: Bonsai structural analysis: easier load authoring, then a PyNite solver
question_paraphrase: Applying, editing and seeing loads is hard and nothing analyses the model.
answer_summary: Debate on storing results in IFC.

gloss_en: Support geometry for IfcStructural* analytical model classes in web-ifc.
title_original: Allow to get the geometry of Ifc Structural analytical model items
question_paraphrase: Needs to display FEM classes (curve member, load group, etc).
answer_summary: Reclassified as feature request.

gloss_en: web-ifc crashes with WASM memory errors on large Revit IFC4 MEP models.
title_original: GetFlatMesh/GetLine crashes with WASM memory errors on large Revit-exported IFC4 MEP models
question_paraphrase: Intermittent aborts in GetFlatMesh/GetLine.
answer_summary: Fix pending PR.

gloss_en: Angled pipes from German Bausoft CAD IFC4 export not visible.
title_original: Bausoft CAD IFC 4 pipe not showing
question_paraphrase: Angled pipes invisible in viewer.
answer_summary: Likely fixed in latest.

gloss_en: Engineers want Eurocode checks, load envelopes and solver-independent results on IFC models.
title_original: Structural analysis in Bonsai: what I'm working on
question_paraphrase: Commenters want EC2/CTE checks, load combos from National Annexes, colour-coding by compliance.
answer_summary: Developer plans PyNite solver.

gloss_en: Standard BIM workflow in Bonsai across Arch, Structure, MEP.
title_original: A Standard BIM workflow in Bonsai| Arch, Structure, MEP
question_paraphrase: Workflow spanning architecture, structure and MEP in Bonsai.
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: List ducts with their airflow and flag unit scale
prompt: list all IfcDuctSegments with airflow prop, units look off, is it m3/s or ft3/s
expected_behavior: Query IfcDuctSegment, read flow properties, inspect project unit assignments, report values and likely scale issue.

gloss_en: Find elements in MEP model with no system assigned
prompt: which pipes and fittings arent in any IfcSystem? need before coord meeting
expected_behavior: Find IfcFlowSegment/IfcFlowFitting without group assignment to an IfcSystem; list with names and levels.

gloss_en: Show real material vs system material for pipes
prompt: pipes show material = system name (HOT WATER) not copper. can you list pipes and what material they actually have
expected_behavior: Read material associations for IfcPipeSegment, list names, point out system-name materials, suggest where real material may be in psets.

gloss_en: Check whether the model has analysis entities and members
prompt: is there an actual analysis model in this ifc? count structural curve members, point connections and load cases
expected_behavior: Count IfcStructuralAnalysisModel, IfcStructuralCurveMember, IfcStructuralPointConnection, load groups; explain if absent.

gloss_en: Total rebar weight by diameter per slab
prompt: sum rebar weight per diameter for each slab, from IfcReinforcingBar
expected_behavior: Group IfcReinforcingBar by NominalDiameter and host, compute weight from length, area and density or read quantity sets, report table.

gloss_en: Clash ducts versus beams and list pairs
prompt: run clash duct vs structural beams, tolerance 20mm, give me the pairs and levels
expected_behavior: Run clash between IfcDuctSegment and IfcBeam sets with tolerance, list GlobalIds, names, storeys.

gloss_en: Find columns and beams missing material or profile
prompt: which columns/beams have no material or profile assigned
expected_behavior: Check IfcColumn/IfcBeam for material associations and profile sets; list offenders.

gloss_en: Change reducers from CONNECTOR to TRANSITION
prompt: set predefined type TRANSITION on all reducer pipe fittings
expected_behavior: Find IfcPipeFitting with different port diameters, set PredefinedType TRANSITION, report changes.

gloss_en: Group ducts by system and total length
prompt: посчитай длину воздуховодов по системам, в ифс они в IfcSystem вроде
expected_behavior: Group IfcDuctSegment by IfcSystem and sum lengths, report table, note missing system links.

prompt: из робота выгрузил ифс, в ревит колонны пришли обобщенными, как сделать чтоб были колоннами
expected_behavior: Explain import class mapping, IfcColumn vs proxy, check the import mapping file, advise linking vs opening.

gloss_en: Check rebar elements missing diameter
prompt: 帮我查一下模型里哪些钢筋没有直径参数
expected_behavior: List IfcReinforcingBar with missing NominalDiameter, give IDs.

prompt: 机电管线和结构梁碰撞结果导出成bcf，按楼层分组
expected_behavior: Run clash, group by storey, export BCF.

gloss_en: List pipe nominal diameters
prompt: gib mir alle Rohre mit Nennweite und Material, TGA Modell
